missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Командир' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'отдал'. 'Наш' is the agreeing masculine possessive, and 'приказ' is the accusative object. A clean introduction.

Strategic focus: Animate accusative equals genitive. 'Командира' takes the -а ending because the noun is animate masculine, so its accusative copies the genitive. 'Своего' agrees in the animate masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Командира' is the genitive showing whose tent it is. 'Нашего' is the agreeing masculine genitive. A core possession pattern.
Strategic focus: Dative indirect object. 'Командиру' is the dative recipient of the report. The verb 'доложил' takes a dative person, and 'о ситуации' adds the prepositional topic.

missions.phrase: Я поехал на фронт с командиром.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after 'с'. 'Командиром' is the instrumental after the preposition 'с', meaning together with. 'На фронт' shows the accusative destination of motion.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Командире' is the prepositional form after 'о', expressing the topic written about. 'В газете' gives a second prepositional, this one of location.

Strategic focus: Genitive in a possession frame. 'Командира' follows 'у' in the genitive to express possession. 'Важная задача' is the nominative thing possessed, with 'была' agreeing in the feminine.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Командиры' is the nominative plural as the subject of 'прибыли'. 'Новые' agrees as a plural adjective, and 'на базу' shows the accusative destination.

Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural equals genitive. 'Командиров' takes the genitive-plural -ов ending, which serves as the accusative because the noun is animate. 'Своих' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative predicate noun. 'Командир' is nominative as the predicate. 'Смелый' and 'опытный' are agreeing masculine adjectives describing his qualities, joined by 'и'.
